prompt: A gaunt spectral specter of tattered grey-black funeral shrouds, its lower body dissolving into wisps of shadow as it dies, faces south-west in the left of the frame. Its skeletal claw has seized a terrified soldier in dented steel plate armor by the throat and drags him to the right into a swirling vortex of obsidian-and-violet eldritch void energy that is unmaking him, the soldier already half-erased, his legs and arm faded to nothing as he is banished from existence. Wine-purple light from the void is the only light source. The background is a desolate, fog-choked graveyard of leaning tombstones in muted dark teal.
